title: Radiation Pattern Shape
description: Essential Criteria - The response must include the correct expression for the radiation pattern of a single antenna.

title: Interference Pattern
description: Essential Criteria - The response must provide the correct expression for the interference pattern when both antennas are driven in phase.

title: Frequency Stability Requirement
description: Essential Criteria - The response must state the requirement for frequency stability of the transmitters to maintain the interference pattern.

title: Correct Use of Variables
description: Important Criteria - The response should correctly identify and use variables such as k, R, and alpha in the expressions.

title: Labeling of Sketches
description: Important Criteria - The response should include properly labeled sketches to illustrate the radiation patterns.

title: Coherency Explanation
description: Optional Criteria - The response may explain the concept of partial coherence and its relevance to the problem.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The response should avoid common sign errors in the expressions for intensity and frequency stability.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria - The response must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
